title: Settings: replace the old tabbed screen, integrations, providers, trading account
owns: the route table for settings pages (shell/routes.ts, shell/pages.tsx)
the three old rows in SettingsRoot.tsx

steps.name: legacy-trio
steps.lead_notes:
These entries are one job. The reference has no «النماذج العالمية», «الصوت» or «التداول» rows in the settings root, and no tab strip inside settings. The lead's decision:
- Remove the three rows and the old tabbed overlay.
- Model routing and the allowed-models list keep all their logic and API calls and move to a new inner page `/app/models`, built from the settings primitives, opened by a «النماذج» row under التكاملات › الذكاء الاصطناعي next to «مزوّدو النماذج». The duplicate provider/key form goes away: `/app/provider/<id>` is the one form.
- Voice: a «المكالمات الصوتية» row in the same section shows readiness from the voice status API and opens `/app/provider/openai`. That is also the Q58 target. No GPT-Live or WebRTC wording; Arabic copy in the Q19 vocabulary.
- Trading: the stop/resume control for new trades (the global brake) gets a row with a confirm sheet under التكاملات › حسابات التداول. This is a money-safety control: it must stay reachable, keep its exact server calls and wording, and exits stay allowed. The duplicate broker form goes away: `/app/broker` is the one form.
- `/app/settings?tab=models`, `?tab=voice`, `?tab=trading` keep working as redirects to the new places.
- Retarget every remaining in-app link to the old tabs, except in PermissionMenu.tsx (package `popover` does it) and AgentPage.tsx (package `agent` does it).
- Delete the old overlay files once nothing imports them. Keep components that pages/Trading.tsx or others still import.
Update the Playwright specs that open the old tabs so they assert the new places.

gaps.title: «النماذج العالمية · الصوت · التداول» open an old tabbed screen with no back button, its own tab strip, and a ?tab= that does not follow the tab
gaps.reference_evidence: DESIGN_TREE_37.md:10: inner pages have a glass back button and their name as the first content; settings rows open inner pages (go(route) at Lonora-Desktop-37.html:3127, back button at 3511/3515). The reference has no tab strip inside settings.
gaps.app_evidence: SettingsRoot.tsx:330-332 link to /app/settings?tab=models|voice|trading. pages.tsx:206-216 renders the legacy SettingsOverlay under `.legacy-surface` on the root settings route, so there is no back button and the bottom nav stays on settings. pages/SettingsOverlay.tsx:7-11 switches tabs in local state (setTab), so the URL stays ?tab=models after tapping «الصوت» (live, both sizes). The strip «النماذج العالمية · الصوت · التداول» duplicates the three settings rows (shots/nav/phone-settings-tab-models.png, which also shows the old look: bordered cards and native select).
gaps.owner_sees: Tapping «النماذج العالمية» from settings opens a screen that looks like the main settings tab, with no back arrow, a second tab bar repeating the rows they just came from, and a URL and system Back that do not follow the tab they pick.
gaps.fix_plan: Make each one an inner settings page: add `models`, `voice` and `trading-settings` (or similar) to PAGES and SETTINGS_PAGES in routes.ts, give them Route entries in pages.tsx that render the panel body in the shell's page layout (float-back plus title, as the other settings pages do), and drop SettingsSidebar from SettingsOverlay. Point SettingsRoot.tsx:330-332, AgentPage.tsx:161/353 and useSettingsRedirect at the new paths, and keep ?tab=models|voice|trading as redirects in settingsMoved. If the strip must stay for now, at least sync it with nav.go(`/app/settings?tab=${t}`, {replace:true}) and show a back button.
gaps.verifier_note: The full conversion to new inner routes is M or larger, since model routing and trading controls have no reference design. Cheaper and safer first step: wrap the legacy panel in the shell's inner-page layout (float-back plus title) and drop the SettingsSidebar tab strip so each row opens exactly one panel. Do not change money-related trading controls' behaviour. Overlaps with the leftover-pages gap on pages.tsx and routes.ts: edit both in one pass.

gaps.title: The old tabbed settings screen (?tab=models|voice|trading) traps navigation: the address does not follow the tab, there is no back button, and the Settings tab does not leave it
gaps.reference_evidence: Every settings destination in the reference is its own route reached by `R(label, icon, route)` (3686-3691) and opens as an inner page with the floating back. The reference has no in-page tab strip inside settings. DESIGN_TREE_37.md 86-89 (settings groups) and its back-order section.
gaps.app_evidence: apps/web/src/shell/pages.tsx:204-217: SettingsPage renders <Legacy><SettingsOverlay initialTab/> under the root tab's large title «الإعدادات». apps/web/src/pages/SettingsOverlay.tsx:7 keeps the tab in useState, so the URL never changes. Live check (scripts/settings/s2.mjs, s5.mjs): after tapping «الصوت» then «التداول» the URL is still /app/settings?tab=models; on a phone, tapping the bottom-bar «الإعدادات» tab from /app/settings?tab=trading leaves the URL at ?tab=trading; no back control exists. Screenshots: shots/settings/app-phone-trading.png, app-desk-trading.png.
gaps.owner_sees: On the phone, a tap on «النماذج العالمية», «الصوت» or «التداول» opens a page that looks like the settings root with a row of pills. Tapping «الإعدادات» in the tab bar does not get back to the settings list. In the installed app, which has no browser back button, the only way out is another tab. A reload or a shared link reopens the first tab, not the one on screen.
gaps.fix_plan: Remove the tabbed screen rather than patch it. Once the three gaps below give each feature a reference home, delete the `settingsTabs` branch in pages.tsx:209-216 and map the old keys in `settingsMoved` (models → /app/providers, voice → /app/providers or the voice row, trading → /app/integrations), so that old links still land on a real page. Delete apps/web/src/pages/SettingsOverlay.tsx and settings-sidebar.tsx, and drop the `Settings` lazy import and the `SettingsTab` type import. Until then, the minimum fix is to give each tab a page route with the floating back.
gaps.verifier_note: This is the consequence of gaps 2, 3 and 4, so do it last, after they are done. It cannot be fully done alone, because tab=models is also linked from Conversation.tsx:612 and PermissionMenu.tsx:492; repoint those to /app/providers when the tab is removed. Add models, voice and trading to settingsMoved. Delete settingsTabs, the Settings lazy import and the SettingsTab type import. Check that SettingsOverlay and settings-sidebar have no other users, and update any tests that cite ?tab=.

gaps.fix_plan: Remove the «النماذج العالمية» row. In ProvidersPage, under the providers group, add two sections in reference containers. «التوجيه العالمي»: a .group of rows for mode (تلقائي / نموذج واحد) and the default and voice models, each opening a pop-opt picker like the composer's model page. «النماذج المسموح بها»: rows with remove, plus «إضافة نموذج». gaps.verifier_note: The cost is design cleanliness, not money or safety, so medium. Keep the routing and allowed-models logic and the API calls unchanged, and only change the markup into .group rows. Do not lose the per-agent or global model validation. Overlaps with gap 1 on tab=models links from the conversation (612) and the permission menu (492). Give the integrations «مزوّدو النماذج» row its count only if it is cheap.

gaps.title: «الصوت» is a dead end, and the Q58 «Open voice settings» button lands on it

gaps.app_evidence: SettingsRoot.tsx:331 row «الصوت» → ?tab=voice. apps/web/src/pages/VoiceSettingsOverlay.tsx:12-38 is a .card of explanatory text («يتصل GPT-Live مباشرة عبر WebRTC…»), at most a status line «Configure an OpenAI credential with GPT-Live API access», and no button. apps/web/src/shell/agent/AgentPage.tsx:150-163 «Calls are not set up» → «Open voice settings» → /app/settings?tab=voice. Screenshot shots/settings/app-phone-voice.png (the status line had not loaded and nothing on the page is actionable).
gaps.owner_sees: Tapping «فتح إعدادات الصوت» after a call fails opens a technical paragraph about WebRTC and GPT-Live with nothing to tap. The owner cannot add the key from there.
gaps.fix_plan: Remove the «الصوت» row. In IntegrationsPage, in the «الذكاء الاصطناعي» section, show a voice state row («المكالمات الصوتية» with the value «جاهزة» or «تحتاج مفتاح OpenAI», from /voice/status) that opens /app/provider/openai, or the providers page when OpenAI is configured but lacks voice access. Point AgentPage.tsx:161 and the call screen's not-configured button at that destination. Delete VoiceSettingsOverlay.tsx.
gaps.verifier_note: Simplest fix: point AgentPage.tsx:161 and the call screen's not-configured button at /app/provider/openai (or /app/providers) and drop the Voice row. Optionally add a status row in IntegrationsPage from /voice/status. Do not touch the call logic. Delete VoiceSettingsOverlay only after nothing else imports it. Do this before removing the tab (gap 1).

Remove the duplicate provider and key form. Retarget Conversation.tsx:612 and PermissionMenu.tsx:492, which both point to tab=models, and keep tab=models as a redirect alias. Do not drop the model routing functionality, because the quota and model-error recovery flows depend on it. Overlaps with the voice gap (new route and settingsTabs edits) and the trading gap (shared SettingsRoot rows, settingsTabs and pages.tsx edits), so do them together.

gaps.verifier_note: Move TradingStatus (stop/resume, with a confirm) into the Integrations > trading accounts page before removing the legacy tab, and keep tab=trading as an alias redirect to /app/integrations. Run the trading-safety tests and the tests that look for «استئناف التداول». Overlaps with gap 4, whose AgentPage link target must change at the same time.

gaps.title: Settings rows «النماذج العالمية»/«الصوت»/«التداول» open the old SettingsOverlay with its own tab bar and palette
gaps.reference_evidence: DESIGN_TREE_37.md:55-73: the settings tree has no models, voice or trading rows; model providers are under التكاملات › مزوّدو النماذج, the broker under التكاملات › ربط حساب تداول. CAPABILITY_MAP.md:360 (OQ47) suggests 'model routing under «مزوّدو النماذج»'; OWNER_DECISIONS Q57 leaves each homeless feature to be placed per feature.
gaps.app_evidence: shell/settings/SettingsRoot.tsx:330-332 NavRow to /app/settings?tab=models|voice|trading. shell/pages.tsx:180-192 renders lazy pages/SettingsOverlay inside <Legacy>. Settings rows must not be deleted until the replacement exists. Suggest scoping to making them push pages with back and the shared row styling, not deleting the functions. Voice remains phase 6 work.
